title: Feds ransack Chuck Clark's place

tellings.quote: his place was was ransacked by the by the feds

plain: Federal agents are said to have ransacked the home of a man named Chuck Clark in the tiny desert town of Rachel, Nevada, sometime in the 1990s. The UFO investigator James Fox tells Michels this as something he heard, citing George Knapp and Clark. If it is true, the government cared enough about what Clark was doing to go through his place.
